name: New Born — Newborn already enrolled: apply the enrolled member under the claim's group
description: Nine guided steps, one per row of the 092.2 table: check the event hierarchy for PX_092, note the patient's details, the Group Id and the service dates, open Search → Member where the automatic search found the patient, open the patient's row, expand the policy line for the claim's group, apply the selected member to the claim, validate it and pay the claim.

steps.name: Identify the PX_092 event and check the event hierarchy
steps.description: Review the events list in the Event Resolution tab, where the PX_092 event is displayed. This event indicates the claim is missing a valid member code, usually for a newborn. In this flow, the newborn is already enrolled, so the correct member must be found and applied to the claim. Verify whether any other events need to be resolved first per the event hierarchy. If other events are present, resolve those that come before PX_092; if none are present, proceed. In this scenario, no other events are present, so the trainee proceeds.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Event Resolution tab is opened while this step is active. The workspace opens with no tab selected, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: On 'Event Resolution', the Active Edit section shows Edit Code PX_092 with a Hard Edit badge, and All Edits lists PX_092 alone.
steps.checklistItem: Identify the PX_092 event and check the event hierarchy

steps.name: Note the patient's name, DOB, and gender
steps.description: Navigate to Member information tab and note the patient's details from the Patient section: the name from the First name, Middle name, and Last name fields, the date of birth from the DOB field, and the gender from the Sex field (M = Male, F = Female). In this scenario, the patient's DOB is 01/17/2026 and the Sex is M (Male). Also note the Group Id in the Group Information section: you will match it to a policy line on the Search tab, and leaving the Search tab to look it up resets that search.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Member Info tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Member Info', read First Name, Middle Name, Last Name, DOB (01/17/2026) and Sex (M) under Patient, and the Group Id under Group Information.
steps.checklistItem: Note the patient's name, DOB, and gender

steps.name: Note the service dates
steps.description: Note the service dates from the Service from - through field on the Claim Header tab before searching for the members on the contract. In this scenario, the service dates are 01/22/2026 – 01/22/2026.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Claim Header tab is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: On 'Claim Header', read Service from - through under General Claim Data: 01/22/2026 - 01/22/2026.

steps.name: Find the enrolled newborn in the member search
steps.description: Navigate to the Search tab → Member sub-tab to identify the members on the policy/contract. The system automatically searches for the patient using the auto-filled Member ID, First name, Last name, and DOB fields. In this scenario, the automatic search finds the patient and returns one row: the patient's Member ID and name, DOB 01/17/2026, Relationship CHD - Child, Member Code 50, Gender M, State IN. This matches the patient details noted from the Member Information tab, confirming the newborn is already enrolled, so no new member code needs to be assigned.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Search → Member sub-tab is opened while this step is active. Sub-tabs start closed, so the trainee opens it deliberately.
steps.hint: Click 'Search', then the 'Member' sub-tab. The one row under the Search Member form is the patient: CHD - Child, Member Code 50.
steps.checklistItem: Find the enrolled newborn in the member search

steps.name: Expand the patient's row
steps.description: Select the patient by clicking the row returned by the search. The row expands to list all the policies available for the patient, from which the one applicable to the claim must be identified.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the patient's row is opened while this step is active.
steps.hint: Click the patient's row, or the arrow at its left.

steps.name: Expand the policy for the claim's group
steps.description: Expand the policy line whose Group number/ID matches the Group Id on the Member Information tab, noted in step 2. Its Effective Date and End Date cover the 01/22/2026 service date. Expanding the line displays two buttons: Open Member Detail and Apply Selected Member.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when the line whose Group # matches the claim's Group Id is expanded. The other group's line expands without completing anything.
steps.hint: Match the Group # column to the Group Id from 'Member Info': it is the line whose Group # ends in M001; the line ending in M002 belongs to another group. Click the arrow at its left.
steps.checklistItem: Expand the policy for the claim's group

steps.name: Apply the selected member to the claim
steps.description: Click the Apply Selected Member button to apply the selected member (member code 50) to the claim. Member Code on the Member Info tab then reads 50.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes only when Apply Selected Member is pressed on the line for the claim's group. The same button on the other group's line applies nothing.
steps.hint: On the expanded line for the claim's group, click 'Apply Selected Member'.
steps.checklistItem: Apply the selected member to the claim

steps.name: Validate the claim
steps.description: Click the Validate button on the claim summary to validate the applied member details. The System message under Member Code on the Member Info tab then reads Member code: 50 - Male dependent, and the Validation section on the Event Resolution tab shows PX_092 as resolved.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when Validate is pressed while Member Code reads 50, which only Apply Selected Member on the claim's policy line writes. Any other Member Code is refused, and the System message asks for the member to be applied.
steps.hint: Validate sits on the claim summary bar, next to Submit. Member Code on 'Member Info' reads 50 once the member is applied.

steps.name: Submit Pay decision
steps.description: Once the correct member has been applied to the claim, choose Pay from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit on the claim summary bar.
steps.completionTriggerNote: Completes when the Pay decision is submitted.
steps.hint: Choose 'Pay' from the Action menu in the header, then click Submit.
